name: Otsuka Corporation
summary: Otsuka Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides information services in Japan. It operates through System Integration Business, and Service and Support Business segments. The System Integration Business segment offers computers, copiers, and communication equipment and software, as well as consigned software development and other activities. This segment also provides system services, such as consulting, system design and development, transport and installation work, and network construction services.
